entries.title: James 3:1
segments: ¶My brethren, let not many of you become teachers, knowing that we shall receive a stricter judgment.

entries.title: James 3:2
segments: For we all stumble in many things. If anyone does not stumble in word, he [is] a perfect man, able also to bridle the whole body.

entries.title: James 3:3
segments: Indeed, we put bits in horses' mouths that they may obey us, and we turn their whole body.

entries.title: James 3:4
segments: Look also at ships: although they are so large and are driven by fierce winds, they are turned by a very small rudder wherever the pilot desires.

entries.title: James 3:5
segments: Even so the tongue is a little member and boasts great things. See how great a forest a little fire kindles!

entries.title: James 3:6
segments: And the tongue [is] a fire, a world of iniquity. The tongue is so set among our members that it defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature; and it is set on fire by hell.

entries.title: James 3:7
segments: For every kind of beast and bird, of reptile and creature of the sea, is tamed and has been tamed by mankind.

entries.title: James 3:8
segments: But no man can tame the tongue. [It is] an unruly evil, full of deadly poison.

entries.title: James 3:9
segments: With it we bless our God and Father, and with it we curse men, who have been made in the similitude of God.

entries.title: James 3:10
segments: Out of the same mouth proceed blessing and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not to be so.

entries.title: James 3:11
segments: Does a spring send forth fresh [water] and bitter from the same opening?

entries.title: James 3:12
segments: Can a fig tree, my brethren, bear olives, or a grapevine bear figs? Thus no spring yields both salt water and fresh.

entries.title: James 3:13
segments: ¶Who [is] wise and understanding among you? Let him show by good conduct [that] his works [are done] in the meekness of wisdom.

entries.title: James 3:14
segments: But if you have bitter envy and self-seeking in your hearts, do not boast and lie against the truth.

entries.title: James 3:15
segments: This wisdom does not descend from above, but [is] earthly, sensual, demonic.

entries.title: James 3:16
segments: For where envy and self-seeking [exist], confusion and every evil thing [are] there.

entries.title: James 3:17
segments: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, willing to yield, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality and without hypocrisy.

entries.title: James 3:18
segments: Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.
